e.title: APRA 澳洲养老金（superannuation）统计：基金级/产品级/行业级季度数据
e.title_en: APRA Australian superannuation statistics: fund-level, product-level and industry quarterly data
e.title_hk: APRA 澳洲養老金（superannuation）統計：基金級/產品級/行業級季度數據
e.summary: 澳洲审慎监管局养老金统计族：基金级/产品级/行业级季度 CSV+XLSX，含 2004 年起业绩序列与「默认保险设计」数据
e.summary_en: APRA’s superannuation statistics family: fund-, product- and industry-level quarterly CSV/XLSX, with performance backseries from 2004 and a default insurance design dataset
e.summary_hk: 澳洲審慎監管局養老金統計族：基金級/產品級/行業級季度 CSV+XLSX，含 2004 年起業績序列與「默認保險設計」數據
e.body:
**APRA（澳大利亚审慎监管局）的 superannuation（养老金）统计族**——这是**澳洲强制性养老金体系**的官方季度数据源，也是本会话按**解冻窗口**扫到并收录的最后一条。可核实信息：**发布时间实测均取自 APRA 官方 RSS**（`apra.gov.au/rss.xml`，HTTP 200、`application/rss+xml`、约 200KB），其中**三条发布于 Wed, 09 Sep 2026**（**正好落在解冻窗口内**）、一条为 Mon, 31 Aug 2026；**四个发布页均 HTTP 200 实测**（每页约 1MB）。

**本次逐页抓取了真实的数据文件链接（不是只读标题）**：

| 发布 | 数据文件（实测链接，节选） |
|---|---|
| **Quarterly Superannuation Product Statistics（QSPS，2026-09-09）** | `QSPS June 2026 CSV files – Table 1a-1b.zip`、`… Table 2-11.zip`、`Quarterly Superannuation Product Publication – Performance – June 2026.xlsx`、`… Product Structure – June 2026.xlsx`、**`Historical SAA – June 2026.csv`（战略资产配置）**、**`Historical performance – June 2026.csv`**、**`Default Insurance Design.zip`** ——共 **7 个文件**，页面自述「**for ease of data usage the QSPS is split into three files**」 |
| **Quarterly Fund-Level Statistics（2026-09-09）** | `Quarterly Superannuation Fund Statistics June 2026.xlsx`、**`Quarterly fund-level statistics database version June 2026.zip`** |
| **Quarterly Superannuation Industry Publication（2026-09-09）** | **`Key Metrics Dataset – Asset Allocation.csv`**、**`– Industry Composition.csv`**、**`– Membership.csv`**、`Quarterly Superannuation Industry Publication – June 2026.xlsx` |
| **Quarterly superannuation statistics（2026-08-31）** | `Quarterly MySuper statistics backseries September 2013 to June 2020.xlsx`、`Quarterly MySuper statistics from September 2020 to June 2026.xlsx`、**`Quarterly superannuation performance statistics – December 2004 to June 2026.xlsx`（20+ 年序列）** |

页面正文中实测出现的关键词包括 **MySuper、RSE、fee**（费率）等，即覆盖**产品结构、业绩、费率、资产配置、行业构成与成员数**等维度。

对 RIAA：**池内在 superannuation 这一块此前是 0 条**（实测检索 `superannuation`、`super`、`fund-level`、`pension fund` 均无命中）——而澳洲养老金是**全球规模最大的强制性养老金体系之一**，这份数据的三层粒度恰好对应三类研究：**① 基金级（fund-level）**——按基金看资产、成员、收益与费率，适合**费率与业绩关系、规模效应、治理比较**一类题目（可直接对照香港的 [[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[mpfa]] 与强制性公积金考试 [[mpfe]]）；**② 产品级（product-level）**——含**战略资产配置（SAA）与历史业绩**，适合**资产配置与长期回报分析**；**③ 行业级**——资产配置/行业构成/成员数的「Key Metrics」三个 CSV，适合市场结构描述。

⭐ **其中一条对精算最直接**：QSPS 里的 **`Default Insurance Design`（默认保险设计）** 数据集——澳洲养老金**在退休储蓄内嵌默认的人寿与 TPD（全残）团体保险**，也就是说**保险嵌在养老金里**，这既是**团险定价与经验分析**的真实场景，也是**「养老金 + 保险」制度设计**的比较样本；对本 wiki 已有的 [[lifeinsurer]]、[[open-life-au]]、[[lifepack]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]] 与 [[retirement-planning]] 正好补上**澳洲官方数据**这一侧。**② 与既有 APRA 条目的关系**：[[apra-insurance-statistics]] 覆盖**一般险/寿险/私康险**，[[apra-mcp]] 是**让 agent 用自然语言查 APRA 数据**的 MCP，[[data-gov-au]] 是**开放数据门户**（含 APRA 逐机构季度统计）——本条目补的是**养老金这一条独立业务线**（APRA 的四个监管板块之一），四者合起来才完整。跨市场对照可看 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]、[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]、[[fss-korea-insurance]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[osfi-canada-data]]、[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]、[[bnm-insurance-takaful]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**发布页 HTTP 200、发布时间（RSS `pubDate`）与数据文件链接（href）**，**但未下载、未打开任何 XLSX/CSV/ZIP 文件**，因此**不能确认其内部字段与数据质量**；**②** 页面体积大（约 1MB）且含前端脚本，本次文本提取基于服务端 HTML，**个别正文段落可能未完全捕获**；**③** 「默认保险设计」等文件的**具体字段未核实**，其存在仅由链接与文件名确认；**④** 养老金与保险**不是同一业务线**——本条目收录理由是**官方权威数据 + 基金级粒度 + 内嵌团险**这三点与精算/保险研究直接相关，**不主张它属于保险监管统计**；**⑤** APRA 按季发布，本次实测的最新季度为 **June 2026**。**核实说明**：APRA RSS（HTTP 200）、四个发布页（各 HTTP 200）、页面内数据文件链接与正文关键词均实测；**未下载或解析任何数据文件**。
e.body_en:
**APRA’s superannuation statistics family** — the official quarterly data source for **Australia’s compulsory pension system**, and the last entry harvested by this session’s **thaw-window** sweep. Verifiable details: publication dates were read from **APRA’s official RSS feed** (`apra.gov.au/rss.xml`, HTTP 200, `application/rss+xml`, ~200KB), of which **three were published Wed, 09 Sep 2026** (**inside the thaw window**) and one on Mon, 31 Aug 2026; **all four publication pages returned HTTP 200** (each ~1MB).

**Real data-file links were extracted page by page here (not merely titles)**:

| Publication | Data files (measured links, excerpt) |
|---|---|
| **Quarterly Superannuation Product Statistics (QSPS, 2026-09-09)** | `QSPS June 2026 CSV files – Table 1a-1b.zip`, `… Table 2-11.zip`, `Quarterly Superannuation Product Publication – Performance – June 2026.xlsx`, `… Product Structure – June 2026.xlsx`, **`Historical SAA – June 2026.csv` (strategic asset allocation)**, **`Historical performance – June 2026.csv`**, **`Default Insurance Design.zip`** — **7 files**; the page states "**for ease of data usage the QSPS is split into three files**" |
| **Quarterly Fund-Level Statistics (2026-09-09)** | `Quarterly Superannuation Fund Statistics June 2026.xlsx`, **`Quarterly fund-level statistics database version June 2026.zip`** |
| **Quarterly Superannuation Industry Publication (2026-09-09)** | **`Key Metrics Dataset – Asset Allocation.csv`**, **`– Industry Composition.csv`**, **`– Membership.csv`**, `Quarterly Superannuation Industry Publication – June 2026.xlsx` |
| **Quarterly superannuation statistics (2026-08-31)** | `Quarterly MySuper statistics backseries September 2013 to June 2020.xlsx`, `Quarterly MySuper statistics from September 2020 to June 2026.xlsx`, **`Quarterly superannuation performance statistics – December 2004 to June 2026.xlsx` (20+ year series)** |

Keywords measured in the page text include **MySuper, RSE and fee**, i.e. the coverage spans **product structure, performance, fees, asset allocation, industry composition and membership**.

For RIAA: **the corpus previously had zero superannuation entries** (searches for `superannuation`, `super`, `fund-level` and `pension fund` all returned nothing) — and Australian superannuation is **one of the largest compulsory pension systems in the world**. Its three levels of granularity map onto three kinds of research: **① fund-level** — assets, members, returns and fees per fund, suited to **fee-versus-performance, scale effects and governance comparisons** (readily compared with Hong Kong’s [[mpf-fund-platform]], [[mpfa]] and the MPF exam [[mpfe]]); **② product-level** — including **strategic asset allocation (SAA) and historical performance**, suited to **asset allocation and long-horizon return analysis**; **③ industry-level** — the three Key Metrics CSVs on asset allocation, industry composition and membership, suited to market-structure description.

⭐ **One dataset is directly actuarial**: the **`Default Insurance Design`** dataset in QSPS — Australian superannuation funds **embed default group life and TPD (total and permanent disability) insurance inside retirement savings**, so **insurance sits inside the pension**. That is both a real setting for **group insurance pricing and experience analysis** and a comparative sample of **"pension plus insurance" scheme design**; it complements the corpus’s [[lifeinsurer]], [[open-life-au]], [[lifepack]], [[longevity-mortality-investor]] and [[retirement-planning]] with an **Australian official data** side. **② Relationship to existing APRA entries**: [[apra-insurance-statistics]] covers **general, life and private health insurance**; [[apra-mcp]] is the MCP that lets agents query APRA data in natural language; [[data-gov-au]] is the **open-data portal** (including APRA institution-level quarterly statistics). This entry adds **superannuation as a separate line of business** (one of APRA’s four supervised industries) — all four together complete the picture. Cross-market comparisons: [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[oecd-insurance-data]], [[naic-financial-data-repository]], [[tii-taiwan-insurance]], [[japan-life-insurance-statistics]], [[fss-korea-insurance]], [[mas-insurance-statistics]], [[osfi-canada-data]], [[ojk-insurance-statistics]], [[bnm-insurance-takaful]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified the **publication pages (HTTP 200), their publication dates (RSS `pubDate`) and the data-file links (hrefs)** — **no XLSX/CSV/ZIP file was downloaded or opened**, so **the internal fields and data quality cannot be confirmed**; **②** the pages are large (~1MB) and script-laden, and the text extraction here was from server-rendered HTML, so **some body text may not have been captured**; **③** the **specific fields** of files such as "Default Insurance Design" **were not verified** — their existence rests on links and file names only; **④** superannuation and insurance are **not the same line of business** — the grounds for inclusion here are **authoritative official data, fund-level granularity and embedded group insurance** being directly relevant to actuarial and insurance research, and **no claim is made that this is insurance regulatory statistics**; **⑤** APRA publishes quarterly and the latest quarter measured here is **June 2026**. **Verification note**: the APRA RSS feed (HTTP 200), all four publication pages (HTTP 200 each), and the in-page data-file links and body keywords were measured; **no data file was downloaded or parsed**.
e.body_hk:
**APRA（澳洲審慎監管局）的 superannuation（養老金）統計族**——**澳洲強制性養老金體系**的官方季度數據源，也是本會話按**解凍窗口**掃到並收錄的最後一條。可核實資訊：發布時間**實測取自 APRA 官方 RSS**（`apra.gov.au/rss.xml`，HTTP 200、`application/rss+xml`、約 200KB），其中**三條發布於 Wed, 09 Sep 2026**（**正好落在解凍窗口內**）、一條為 Mon, 31 Aug 2026；**四個發布頁均 HTTP 200 實測**（每頁約 1MB）。

**本次逐頁抓取了真實的數據文件鏈接**：

| 發布 | 數據文件（實測鏈接，節選） |
|---|---|
| **QSPS 產品級統計（2026-09-09）** | `QSPS June 2026 CSV files – Table 1a-1b.zip`、`… Table 2-11.zip`、`… Publications – Performance – June 2026.xlsx`、`… Product Structure – June 2026.xlsx`、**`Historical SAA – June 2026.csv`（戰略資產配置）**、**`Historical performance – June 2026.csv`**、**`Default Insurance Design.zip`**（共 **7 個文件**） |
| **基金級統計（2026-09-09）** | `Quarterly Superannuation Fund Statistics June 2026.xlsx`、**`Quarterly fund-level statistics database version June 2026.zip`** |
| **行業級發布（2026-09-09）** | **`Key Metrics Dataset – Asset Allocation.csv`**、**`– Industry Composition.csv`**、**`– Membership.csv`**、`… Industry Publication – June 2026.xlsx` |
| **季度養老金統計（2026-08-31）** | MySuper 統計回溯（2013-09 至 2020-06）、MySuper 統計（2020-09 至 2026-06）、**`Quarterly superannuation performance statistics – December 2004 to June 2026.xlsx`（20+ 年序列）** |

頁面正文實測出現關鍵詞 **MySuper、RSE、fee**，即覆蓋**產品結構、業績、費率、資產配置、行業構成與成員數**。

對 RIAA：**池內 superannuation 此前是 0 條**——而澳洲養老金是**全球規模最大的強制性養老金體系之一**。三層粒度對應三類研究：**基金級**（按基金看資產/成員/收益/費率，適合費率與業績、規模效應、治理比較，可對照香港 [[mpf-fund-platform]]、[[mpfa]]、[[mpfe]]）；**產品級**（含**戰略資產配置 SAA 與歷史業績**）；**行業級**（資產配置/行業構成/成員數三個 CSV）。

⭐ **其中一條對精算最直接**：QSPS 中的 **`Default Insurance Design`（默認保險設計）** 數據集——澳洲養老金**在退休儲蓄內嵌默認的人壽與 TPD 團體保險**，**保險嵌在養老金裡**，是**團險定價與經驗分析**的真實場景，也是「**養老金 + 保險**」制度設計的比較樣本；補上本 wiki 已有 [[lifeinsurer]]、[[open-life-au]]、[[lifepack]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]、[[retirement-planning]] 的**澳洲官方數據**一側。**與既有 APRA 條目的關係**：[[apra-insurance-statistics]] 覆蓋**一般險/壽險/私康險**，[[apra-mcp]] 是**查 APRA 數據的 MCP**，[[data-gov-au]] 是**開放數據門戶**——本條目補的是**養老金這一條獨立業務線**。跨市場對照見 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[oecd-insurance-data]]、[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]、[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]、[[fss-korea-insurance]]、[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[osfi-canada-data]]、[[ojk-insurance-statistics]]、[[bnm-insurance-takaful]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**發布頁 HTTP 200、發布時間（RSS pubDate）與數據文件鏈接**，**但未下載、未打開任何 XLSX/CSV/ZIP**，故**無法確認其內部欄位與數據質量**；**②** 頁面體積大且含前端腳本，文本提取基於服務端 HTML，**個別正文可能未完全捕獲**；**③** 「默認保險設計」等文件的**具體欄位未核實**；**④** 養老金與保險**不是同一業務線**——收錄理由是**官方權威數據 + 基金級粒度 + 內嵌團險**三點與精算/保險研究直接相關；**⑤** APRA 按季發布，本次實測最新季度為 **June 2026**。**核實說明**：APRA RSS、四個發布頁、頁內數據文件鏈接與正文關鍵詞均實測；**未下載或解析任何數據文件**。
